title: Firewall zones cross-zone validation hardening
acceptance_criteria: Zone upsert rejects interfaces already assigned to a different existing zone.
Zone upsert resolves `from_zone` values case-insensitively to existing zone names and preserves canonical names in generated operations.
Zone upsert allows `LOCAL` pseudo-zone mapping and normalizes `local` input to `LOCAL`.
Zone upsert rejects unknown `from_zone` references with explicit 400 errors.
Zone upsert rejects duplicate `from_zone` mappings after canonicalization (e.g., `WAN` and `wan`).
Regression tests cover interface overlap, unknown `from_zone`, canonicalization + LOCAL support, and duplicate detection.
assumptions: Interface assignments must be unique across zones to avoid ambiguous zone-based firewall behavior.
Existing deployments that intentionally referenced non-existent zones in `from` mappings should now fail fast until referenced zones exist.
Browser e2e smoke remains out-of-gate on this host until Playwright shared libraries are installed.

tasks.notes: Added cross-zone interface ownership checks, from-zone canonicalization/validation, LOCAL handling, and duplicate detection after canonicalization.
Added regression tests for interface overlap, unknown from-zone, canonicalization + LOCAL mapping, and duplicate from-zone detection.
